experiment.control: Same new source with explicit feature off; current original per-token conversions.
experiment.treatment: Same source with only gate-cast placement switch on. Source allowlist/difference audit must prove no second behavioral change.
experiment.scope: Integrated27B TP4 HYPIC requests; no independent GDN substitute. Both arms profiler-off for timing. New source-bound contracts/raw roots after implementation/host proof; current R31 roots immutable.
controls: fresh service per arm, same warmup shape; no compiled startup charged to one arm only
one source-level behavioral diff; no cache residency/logging/guard change
experiment.host_gate: Focused exact-value controls forlength1/8/64, FP64/FP32/BF16, grouped heads and noncontiguous inputs; default-off identity; invalid controls fail. CPU passes are not NPU acceptance.
experiment.primary_metric: unprofiled16-request client makespan after same warmup
experiment.pass_rule: Both A controls valid with<=5% relative drift; B makespan <=0.95*mean(A1,A2), intended cast-count reduction, all correctness/mechanism/isolation/release gates. Otherwise rejected or inconclusive as applicable, never success by source resemblance.
experiment.abort: Any numerical/ownership/isolation failure; >20% makespan regression beyond same valid control. Preserve failed root, no blind retries.
experiment.confirmation: Survivor needs new matched formal1024 source-specific pair/repetitions and existing fullquality/lifecycle gates. Diagnostic gain cannot rewrite R30 or certify the paper.
experiment.common_runtime_observer: Both arms same source-bound observer and actual first-shape private output/state comparison vs retained per-token casts, before outer native commit. Timed shapes must have same-process warm proof. Dispatcher counts are Tensor.to call sites, not measured hardware transfers.
